Class SakilaUtils

java.lang.Object
com.me.learning.framework.service.SakilaUtils
public final class SakilaUtils extends Object
General-purpose utility methods shared across all Sakila microservices.

All methods are stateless static helpers — no Spring bean needed. For Bean Validation constraints use the standard annotations from jakarta.validation.constraints instead.
